item.title: Welcome to The Farah Stack
item.description:
This is where I’ll be writing about the systems I build and the ideas I’m chewing on — architecture deep dives, research notes, and the occasional strong opinion about distributed systems and AI agent pipelines.

Expect a mix of:

  • Posts — shorter-form articles and running commentary.
  • Research — longer write-ups from ongoing investigations.
  • Architecture — system design discussions, with diagrams you can actually pan and zoom into.

More soon.
